title: [NSW, SA] AGL Battery Rewards Plan: $150 Sign up Credit, 11.11¢/kWh 10am-2pm, Solar Feed-In Tariff 28¢/kWh 5-9pm @ AGL
body:
Deal: [NSW, SA] AGL Battery Rewards Plan: $150 Sign up Credit, 11.11¢/kWh 10am-2pm, Solar Feed-In Tariff 28¢/kWh 5-9pm @ AGL

[scatman00] Applies to SA, but rates are a bit different.
5pm to 9pm is 26c FIT
10am to 3pm is 21.6c cost
[noz] I'm also in SA, my shoulder period cost quotes at 16.1c/kWh, and is 10AM to 4PM.
[Drag777er] Same for me 10:00 to 16:00 SA, I believe you might have the Sigenergy Sigenstore battery and that might be the reason, since AGL has a slightly different conditions and rates. FIT for me is 27 c
[Bruceflix] No. It's determined by which tariff you are on with SAPN
[Mangoslushie] NSW here and my evening FIT is 29c
Offpeak is 21.63c
[assailantsky] Off peak is 32.12c for me. What's your shoulder rate?
[Royale with cheese] You can also sign up to their VPP in nsw but very limited brands of batteries included currently for them.
[cloudie9] Can anyone explained, why sites like AGL unable to recognize my smart meter, but the smart meter was installed by Origin. Shouldn't that be updated on NMI register?
[3dprintdeals] 'Basic Plan Information Document available upon request'…
[blitzn] Can someone help, i feel like i have the wrong plan for my electricity.
I have a 42kwh battery 12.5kw system, what sort of plan would i benefit most out of?
Im with AGL the solar saver plan its not giving the most out of my system. I only get 8c for the 1st 8kwh then its 3c.
[Xizor] You need to analyse based on your own use and requirements.
[blitzn] We barely use anything
My battery is moslty at 100% by 12pm and by the morning its dropped to about 75%.
I have so much extra and my plan isnt giving me a credit
[assailantsky] Before others could help you, list the following:
* daily usage
* Inverter size
* Daily solar generation
You'll get much better responses.
[blitzn] Yesterdy had 43.4 production, 29 consumption
10kw inveter
Today was 46 production
19 consumption
[ozgameboy] How much your system cost you? 42kW battery and 12.5kWh solar + 10kW inverter?
Why do you need battery so big while your usages is just half its size?
[blitzn] @ozgameboy: Total only cost me 9500 after rebates.
Just got the biggest i could before 1st of may rebate change
[assailantsky] For your system, assuming average of 45 kWh production and 25kWh usage per day over the whole year, that means average export of 20kWh per day. Check out Flow Power's 45c FiT plan, 20 kWh export equals $9.00 credit per day.
[blitzn] @assailantsky: Is that with exporting my battery too or just from the solar?
[assailantsky] @blitzn: Flow Power's 45c/kWh FiT only applies to 5.30-7.30pm for my Sydney property, so you'll be using solar to charge your battery. Only exports during those 2 hours get the 45c/kWh.
[tman2020] @assailantsky: Flopwer plans have changed. Not that good anymore. FiT has gone down and daily supply charge up.
[mateinaus] Did you checkout Powston? I found it very interesting, but my battery size is a bit low to sign up with them.
[tman2020] Go with Globrid. I have a similar solar set up and have been in credit from day one. Set and forget. I'm in Sydney.
[Herb Utsmellz] Not as good as Globird if you import more than export. Most days I'll import ~ 60-70kwh between 11am-2pm for free and only export 15kwh @ 15c between 6-9pm. Add in the $1 daily bonus…
[tman2020] Are you in VIC? Globird FiT is 10c since 1 July apart from VIC. New plans kick in VIC from 1 August. Daily supply charhe has gone up. No change to the $1 zerohero bonus.
[Herb Utsmellz] My bad, thought my bill was still 15c but there were 2 separate date ranges. Still, only 75c difference. A lot of the time I won't feed in 15kw and save it to top the EV up or blast the AC first thing in the morning.
[bigbadboogieman] They had $800 joining credit less than a year ago. The supply charge was roughly $1 for single rate tariff. Gift cards were better because you didn't have to deal with them every quarter to get the credit transferred or refunded.
[tman2020] It is region specific. Not a good deal for South Sydney - off-peak import is 21.6c and peak FiT is 28c. Globird Zerohero is much better.
Supply charge c/day 158.631
Peak c/kWh 54.175
Off peak c/kWh 21.626
Off-peak FiT c/kWh excl GST 3
Evening peak FiT c/kWh excl GST 28
Morning peak FiT c/kWh excl GST. 3
